content.title: Usher Raymond and Chris Brown announce 2026 joint tour, fans worry about high ticket prices
content.text: Two big music stars — Usher Raymond and Chris Brown — are planning a joint tour in 2026 called R&B Tour: Raymond & Brown. The article says this tour could become one of the hottest concert tickets of 2026, even ahead of stars like Bruno Mars, Ariana Grande and Ed Sheeran. The joint tour announcement comes at a time when R&B fans are still debating who is the “King of R&B,” and both singers are often compared with each other. The report says both artists are Grammy winners and can individually sell out shows, so fans expect huge demand when they perform together, as stated by Mens Journal. The tour is being teased as a stadium tour, which usually means larger venues and bigger crowds. Fans are excited but also worried about ticket prices, especially because concert tickets have become very expensive recently. High ticket price fearThe article by Mens Journal notes there has already been backlash this year over high ticket prices for concerts by artists like Bruno Mars and Harry Styles, with some tickets crossing $1,000. Social media users reacted with concern, saying tickets for the Usher-Chris Brown tour could cost “a million dollars” or at least $500. Fans react onlineSome fans also predicted this tour could have the highest ticket prices ever seen for an R&B concert. To compare, the article looked at previous ticket prices for both singers’ recent tours. Usher’s 2024 Past Present Future Tour had tickets starting around $75, while good seats cost about $200–$300, as noted by Mens Journal. Chris Brown’s 2025 Breezy Bowl XX Tour started around $70, with good seats also between $200–$300. The report by Mens Journal explains that VIP packages and floor seats were more expensive for both tours. Because this is a joint tour, demand is expected to be higher than their solo shows. The writer predicts good seats for the new tour could cost around $275 to $350, though official prices are not yet announced. FAQsQ1.
